annotation_cross_check.ground_truth_role: report-level information only; not voxel-level ground truth

interpretation_limitations: Low attenuation is not specific to ventricular CSF.
Intensity thresholds are scanner- and reconstruction-dependent.
TotalSegmentator brain segmentation is not a dedicated ventricular segmentation.
The neural reconstruction is not clinical ground truth.
The structured annotation file is report-level rather than voxel-level ground truth.
Definitive anatomical or pathological interpretation requires expert radiological review.
